What should this teardown help you decide next?

Press Start 2P is very hard to read below ~12px and on phones. Where should pixel type stop, given the 'Readable in 20 seconds' pillar?
answers.answer: Pixel on menus, not in matches

answers.question: Space is your pillar. How much should the UI tell a player about places they are NOT in?
Phone or desktop for your Friday-night friends?
Which numbers in balance.json were chosen by feel and which by testing?
Who will author content later: roles, items, scenes, the round-8 evolutions, laws and events?
A role exists twice: as card text the player reads, and as data the server runs. When they disagree, which wins?
evolutions.json, laws.json and events.json are empty stubs waiting for round 8. What should they be?

Since A49 every seat walks as its card's character, except the three cover roles. So the deduction is mostly 'which of the people who look like X is really X, and who was where'. Is that the heart of the game now?
answers.answer: I am for it to be a mixture of all of those, so no matter how you choose to play there is a way

answers.question: On paper a match is grace with the opening cutscene (up to 150 s), then 4 cycles of 170 s, meetings of about 2 minutes, and a 90 s Final Night. That adds up to about 22 to 25 minutes, against the GDD's 12 to 18. What should happen?
What should the last two minutes of a match feel like?
How much should the world (mobs, crafting, quests, the Train, hunger) compete with the deduction for attention?
The server is one Colyseus process on Railway, stepping every match at 20 Hz, with /health reporting rooms and tick p95. How many matches at once should the first public host carry?
The server already validates every action (range, phase, cooldown) and filters what each client sees by scene. Is cheating a concern for the first audience, or only bugs?
The admin auto-mode runs all-NPC matches at up to 10x, and tools/bots has a soak runner. Should it grow into a balance lab, or stay a bug finder?

Hollowmere has two identities. WORLD 4.1 describes a fog-bound harbour hamlet in 1931: a shuttered tin mine, a dead lord's will, toon-noir. Bible Book I describes a frontier railroad company town run by Railroad Barons, a week's walk from anywhere. Which is Hollowmere?
answers.answer: The bibles version for now but the new upcoming lore is all in “Who did it Narrative Worldbuilding” in pipelines

answers.question: Which Book of the Bible matters most to you? (Book I Hollowmere, II ONUB and Port-au-Levain, III Blackpine, IV the macro-economy and HQ trees, V single-player story mode and the NPC engine, VI engine seams)
answers.answer: Book1, BookV, and Book 1v but if I had to choose one it would be book V the killer dilemmas and state aware NPCs and Environmental effects and mobs.

answers.question: Is the 1931 setting a costume, or should history (the company town, the law, the Depression) carry the theme?
answers.answer: It’s a combination of all of those that make the game

answers.question: Should each map play differently, or feel different around the same rules?

Every rendered or generated image goes through tools/sprites/pixel.ts: snapped to the 64-colour world palette and downscaled to a pixel grid, so the world looks like rendered isometric pixel art. Is that the game's real face?
answers.answer: It’s a mix between ai generated and Rendered Pixel ISO, however the mode can be switched between HD 8 bit and Low poly and all of them render everything in their style

answers.question: About 90 of the 166 credited assets are Higgsfield generations, 67 are your own, and 79 rows are CC0. Where should generated art stop?
answers.answer: I don’t care if everything is AI generated if it looks good. I don’t hate the idea of handrawing and may do it for certain games or pieces but it is absolutely not my go to for large scale works

answers.question: There are 38 sounds today (ambiences for the village, forest, cave and house, plus the bell, doors and crows), 24 of them from your own sound library. What should the game sound like when nothing is happening?

The quick mode (One Night Ultimate Baguette) was born in round 4, rebuilt as ONUB v2 in round 5 from your full ruleset and art, and removed in round 7 (A115), about six days later. What made you decide to remove it?
answers.answer: The directions were misunderstood, I wanted ONUB to become a map and game mode like “HollowMere” and “BlackPine” instead it made what ONUB became in round 5 a flat tile and card based deduction game, super boring and not at all how I saw it going or specified but some context gets lost I guess

answers.question: Which decision would you make differently with what you know now?
Rounds 8 and 9 stage evolutions, the law (Tribunal), an economy (Book IV), Port-au-Levain and story mode with state-aware NPCs (Book V). Which one is the game, and which are features?
When should friends first play a full match?
answers.answer: I’ve had friends playing its first launch, in total I’ve had 5 play tests. Everyone has loved the designs, the thoughts, the story, and everything as it has progressed. The biggest flaw I saw was the actual curve from “I have a cool idea I want to build” to “How to I create a world narrative, how does that narrative present itself in the game play, how can you make this interesting like you would a story with plot twists, anticipation, and more while factoring in actual gameplay” that’s how this went from an among us rip off to what it is now. Through watching people struggle, get board, find bugs, and make suggestions (even if they didn’t intend it as a suggestion). This is what I’ve learned from doing it testing it and responding accordingly. Overall my close friends and family are very impressed and proud while strangers look at me with shock that I did this mostly from my phone and laptop in only a few days, I actually think it’s around week 2 or something.

answers.question: V2 is a first-person 3D game on the same server, rules and world data. Is V2 still the goal, or has the isometric game become the game?
answers.answer: I don’t believe Who did it will ever become a FPO, the game works now, I like the look, and my friends like the look. However that doesn’t mean FPOV won’t be featured in a remake “Who Did It Too?”

answers.question: What would make you stop working on it?
answers.answer: It’s not to prove anything, I’ll be done when something else has my attention, even then I’ll probably still use this first creation as a reference and who knows probably continue to build out new maps, mobs, and play styles forever.

answers.question: Seven rounds of parallel AI sessions built 522 commits in 13 days, and round 8 is running now with 11 sessions (8A to 8K). Was parallel building worth its coordination cost?
Which teardown findings should Game Features and Admin take into round 8? (They will check each one with you in a brief before changing anything.)
answers.answer: Anti-cheat leaks, Canon + data pass, Rules drift, Process, Also make them aware more lore is currently being produced by the other session in pipelines Narrative WorldBuilding and absolutely whatever it says is canon as long as it doesn’t break features without creating a good working solution.

answers.question: Chapter 5's biggest open call: what year is Hollowmere? It decides the next art round's silhouettes and the bakery's kit.
answers.answer: That’s up to the Narrative WorldBuilding Sessions data

answers.question: Chapter 1's open call: your rule is 'paper for what you hold', but A110 made the role card, HUD and notebook glass. Which wins?
answers.answer: Not important, don’t change that rn I haven’t looked at it so I’m unsure. Plus I didn’t like the paper style from before so I’ll probably create a new one if want to go back
